answer_1.quote: We employ human judgment to investigate the quality of the generated continuations ... we generate continuations for the IC prompts ...
datasets: Bott and Solstad 2021 German IC dataset

answer_2.quote: we calculate the three automatic measures: BLEU, ROUGE-L and BERTScore

answer_4.quote: We used the Prolific framework to obtain ratings from 40 different annotators ... presenting three questions ... whether the continuation is a (i) "natural", (ii) "meaningful" (i.e. coherent) and (iii) "surprising" (i.e. informative) explanation
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered three questions rating naturalness, coherence (meaningfulness) and informativeness on a five‑point Likert scale.
